en.summary: Tuesday 10 November 2026: the day after the New Moon in Scorpio, the Moon leaves Scorpio for Sagittarius during the morning and trines Neptune in Aries. Mercury is retrograde in Scorpio and squares Pluto in Aquarius. Venus, retrograde in Libra, makes an exact sextile to Mars, which stays conjunct Jupiter in Leo and opposite the North Node in Aquarius.

signs.belier:
Aries, today the focus shifts toward love, pleasure and creativity: the Moon leaves Scorpio for Sagittarius during the morning, the day after the New Moon. You may feel a pull to plan a trip, sign up for a course or simply widen your horizon after several intense days.

Mercury is still retrograde in Scorpio, in your sector of daily work, health and routines, and squares Pluto in Aquarius, so double-check facts and avoid reading too much into one silence. Venus, retrograde in Libra in your area of partnerships and one-to-one relationships, makes an exact sextile to Mars, while Mars travels with Jupiter in Leo through your sector of travel, study and the beliefs that guide you; this supports repairing and finishing rather than starting from zero.

Pick one idea that excites you and write down the first concrete step, then let it wait a few days before committing money. The sky describes a climate, not a fixed outcome.

Mercure est rétrograde en Scorpion et forme un carré à Pluton en Verseau. Vénus, rétrograde en Balance, forme un sextile exact à Mars, qui reste conjoint à Jupiter en Lion et opposé au Nœud nord en Verseau.
